[[Caza Windedcalf]] is a [[Losaru]] [[Centaur]] [[boss]] that appears in [[the Scar]].

== Locations ==
* [[Crystal Desert]]
** {{NPC location|The Scar}}

== Skills ==
* {{skill icon|Hunter's Shot}}
* {{skill icon|Read the Wind}}
* {{skill icon|Storm Chaser}}

== Items dropped ==
* [[Losaru Mane]]

== Notes ==
* Caza Windedcalf is one of six Losaru centaur bosses that spawns randomly at six spawn points. The spawn points are shared with [[Aguo Gruffmane]], [[Mina Brillianthaunch]], [[Gret Waveringmane]], [[Zalo Soulhaunch]], and [[Doro Icehide]].
* If the [[quest]] [[The Warrior's Path]] is active, [[Orshad Chieftain]] will be at one of the easternmost spawn point, thus replacing one of the normal bosses.
